resources.desc: This is one of the first collections in IR domain, however the dataset is too small for any statistical significance analysis, but is nevertheless suitable for pilot runs.

resources.name: TREC Collections
resources.desc: TREC is the benchmark dataset used by most IR and Web search algorithms. It has several tracks, each of which consists of dataset to test for a specific task. The tracks along with suggested use-case are:

resources.name: Blog
resources.desc: Explore information seeking behavior in the blogosphere.

resources.name: Chemical IR
resources.desc: Address challenges in building large chemical testbeds for chemical IR.

resources.name: Clinical Decision Support
resources.desc: Investigate techniques to link medical cases to information relevant for patient care.

resources.name: Confusion
resources.desc: Study Known Item Searching problem.

resources.name: Contextual Suggestion
resources.desc: Investigate search techniques for complex information needs (context and user interests based).

resources.name: Crowdsourcing
resources.desc: Explore crowdsourcing methods for performing and evaluating search.

resources.name: Enterprise
resources.desc: Study search over the organization data.

resources.name: Entity
resources.desc: Perform entity-related search (find entities and their properties) on Web data.

resources.name: Filtering
resources.desc: Binarily decide retrieval of new incoming documents given a stable information need.

resources.name: Federated Web Search
resources.desc: Study merge performance for results from various search services.

resources.name: Genomics
resources.desc: Study retrieval efficiency of genomics data and corresponding documentation.

resources.name: HARD
resources.desc: Obtain High Accuracy Retrieval from Documents by leveraging searcher's context.

resources.name: Interactive Track
resources.desc: Study user interaction with text retrieval systems.

resources.name: Knowledge base acceleration
resources.desc: Study algorithms that improve efficiency of human Knowledge Base.

resources.name: Legal Track
resources.desc: Study retrieval systems that have high recall for legal documents use case.

resources.name: Medical Track
resources.desc: Explore unstructured search performance over patients record data.

resources.name: Microblog Track
resources.desc: Examine satisfaction of real-time information need for microblogging sites.

resources.name: Million Query Track
resources.desc: Explore ad-hoc retrieval over large set of queries.

resources.name: Novelty Track
resources.desc: Investigate systems' abilities to locate new (non-redundant) information.

resources.name: Question Answering Track
resources.desc: Test systems that scale beyond document retrieval, to retrieve answers to factoid, list and definition type questions.

resources.name: Relevance Feedback Track
resources.desc: For deep evaluation of relevance feedback processes.

resources.name: Robust Track
resources.desc: Study individual topic's effectiveness.

resources.name: Session Track
resources.desc: Develop methods for measuring multiple-query sessions where information needs drift.

resources.name: SPAM Track
resources.desc: Benchmark spam filtering approaches.

resources.name: Tasks Track
resources.desc: Test if systems can induce possible tasks, users might be trying to accomplish for the query.

resources.name: Temporal Summarization Track
resources.desc: Develop systems that allow users to efficiently monitor the information associated with an event over time.

resources.name: Terabyte Track
resources.desc: Test scalability of IR systems to large scale collection.

resources.name: Web Track
resources.desc: Explore information seeking behaviors common in general web search.
